title: Crop Yield Prediction Using Regression Models: A Comparative Evaluation of Model Performance
abstract: arXiv:2610.37022v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable crop-yield prediction can support agricultural planning and resource allocation. This study evaluates five regression models for predicting crop yield from environmental, crop-related, and agricultural management variables. The dataset initially contained 1,000,000 observations and ten variables, with 231 observations having negative target values removed during preprocessing. Categorical variables were represented using one-hot encoding, and Boolean variables were converted into binary values. The models considered were multiple linear regression (LR), random-forest regression (RF), decision-tree regression (DT), ridge regression, and lasso regression. Their performance was evaluated using 80:20 and 70:30 training-testing splits based on the coefficient of determination (R-squared), mean squared error (MSE), and root mean squared error (RMSE). translated_title: 基于回归模型的作物产量预测：模型性能的比较评估
translated_abstract: 可靠的作物产量预测能够支持农业规划和资源配置。本研究评估了五种回归模型，用于基于环境、作物相关和农业管理变量来预测作物产量。数据集最初包含100万条观测数据和十个变量，其中231条目标值为负的观测数据在预处理阶段被剔除。分类变量采用独热编码表示，布尔变量被转换为二进制值。所考虑的模型包括多元线性回归（LR）、随机森林回归（RF）、决策树回归（DT）、岭回归和套索回归。基于决定系数（R²）、均方误差（MSE）和均方根误差（RMSE），采用80:20和70:30的训练-测试划分评估了各模型的性能。在80:20划分下，多元线性回归取得了约0.9130的测试R²，以及……
tldr: 本研究比较了多元线性回归、随机森林、决策树、岭回归和套索回归五种模型在基于环境和农业管理变量预测作物产量中的性能，其中多元线性回归在80:20划分下表现最佳，测试R²达约0.9130。
en_tdlr: This study compares five regression models (linear regression, random forest, decision tree, ridge, and lasso) for crop yield prediction from environmental and agricultural management variables, finding that multiple linear regression achieves the best performance with a test R-squared of approximately 0.9130 under an 80:20 train-test split.
